title: Remove “physical plan” condition
steps:
1. Click Workbench 
2. Click Spark SQL 
3.  Select --> default > Sales Summary

SELECT
  product,
  COUNT(*) as num_sales,
  SUM(amount) as revenue,
  AVG(amount) as avg_sale
FROM sales
WHERE year = 2024
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 30;

4. Click  RUN Query 
5. Click Explain Plan
expected: Showing Physical Plan will create miss information to understand for some users.
actual:
1.	Explain Plan and Format SQL buttons colours are not changed when user clicks/selects that feature. Then it will be easy to understand for which the output showing below container.
2.	Explain Plan showing backend code “Physical Plan” for some queries, hide this code from users for not to get confused them

steps:
